intro: Convert meters (m) to millimeters (mm) accurately for CAD blueprints, architectural site plans, civil engineering schedules, and CNC machining. Because the SI prefix milli- represents one thousandth, 1 meter equals exactly 1,000 millimeters (metres to millimetres). To scale any meter dimension into millimeters, multiply by 1,000—shifting the decimal point three places right—or check exact pre-computed values in the reference table below.
alsoWrittenAs: m to mm, metre to millimetre, meters to millimetres, meter into mm

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Meters to Millimeters vs. Centimeters Decimal Shifts
items: Multiplying meters by 100 yields centimeters, not millimeters. Always multiply by 1,000 (shift the decimal point three places right) when converting meters directly to millimeters.

In architectural and ISO technical drawings, dimensions are commonly labeled in millimeters without repeating 'mm' (for example, 4310 instead of 4.31 m) to eliminate decimal-point transcription mistakes on site.

faqs.question: How many millimeters (mm) are in 1 meter (m)?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 1,000 millimeters in 1 meter (1 m = 1,000 mm). Conversely, 1 millimeter equals 0.001 meters.

faqs.question: How do I convert meters to millimeters?
faqs.answer: Multiply the length in meters by 1,000 (mm = m × 1,000). For example, 4.31 m × 1,000 = 4,310 mm.
